method: Six-slot schedule using measured concurrent rates; profile interpolation for unmeasured batches/depths, 15% training allowance, 0.2s/epoch evaluation/write allowance and 10s startup/run. CV and phase3 vary over actual search space; no test scores used.
uncertainties: GN/LN/IN Batch16, BN64, GN256 not directly measured
ResNet/Plain20/32 depth scaling estimated from ResNet56
BlurPool overhead provision 30%, not full-data measured
mixed profiles short and thermal/CPU contention can change
tails and dropout/augmentation checkpoint overhead approximate
